props.title: Types of Playground Equipment: A Complete Guide with Names
props.summaryText: Every common type of playground equipment explained: what it is called, what it does for children, which ages it suits and where it works best.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Rendering of a large blue and orange multi play station with several slides and towers

takeaways.text: Most playgrounds combine one main multi play station with a few single items such as swings, spring riders and see-saws.
Each type builds different skills: climbing builds strength, swings and spinners build balance, play panels and pretend play build social and thinking skills.
Choose by age group first, then by the space and the number of children at peak time.
Ground-level activities let children who cannot or do not want to climb join in.

faq.q: What are the main types of playground equipment?
faq.a: Multi play stations (combined structures with platforms, slides and climbers), slides, swings, climbers and climbing nets, see-saws, merry-go-rounds and spinners, spring riders, balance equipment, crawl tunnels, play panels, sand and water play, and outdoor gym equipment for older children and adults.

faq.q: What is a multi play station?
faq.a: A multi play station is a combined structure with platforms connected by steps, bridges and climbing elements, with one or more slides and often play panels or roofs. It lets many children play at once in a compact footprint, which is why it is the centrepiece of most school and society playgrounds.

faq.q: What playground equipment is best for toddlers?
faq.a: Low play stations with short slides, toddler swings with enclosed seats, spring riders, crawl tunnels, small climbers with gentle steps, and play panels at ground level.

faq.q: What is the most popular playground equipment?
faq.a: Slides and swings are the most used items in almost every playground we install, followed by multi play stations, spring riders and merry-go-rounds.
